targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', collected_at) AS INTEGER) AS time, vendor, sum(used) AS used_gb, sum(total) AS capacity_gb
FROM capacity WHERE kind='STORAGE' AND collected_at BETWEEN datetime(${__from:date:seconds},'unixepoch') AND datetime(${__to:date:seconds},'unixepoch')
GROUP BY collected_at, vendor ORDER BY time
